youtube.title: Mittens' ABC: F to J! (POUNCE!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🔤 POUNCE! Mittens the cat jumped after a butterfly and knocked all the letter blocks down! Can you help find them?

Learn the letters F, G, H, I and J with Mittens, the nerdiest cat in the kitchen! Each letter block comes back one by one with a word that starts with it: F is for frog, G is for grapes, and more. Then sing the ABC song with Mittens, and stay till the end, because a tiny someone wants to learn the next letter! 🐾

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn the letters F, G, H, I and J
✔️ Hear a word for each letter (F is for frog!)
✔️ Practice early phonics and letter sounds
✔️ Sing a catchy ABC song with Mittens!

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:04 POUNCE! Oh no!
0:09 Let's find the letters!
0:26 Sing along!
0:46 Wait... who's that?
0:56 What starts with K?

💬 What word starts with K? Tell us in the comments!
